newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Aneka Tambang in gold loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Aneka Tambang in gold loan deal.

text.p: Indonesian state mining company PT Aneka Tambang said on Wednesday it has signed a loan agreement for 160,000 troy ounces of gold worth around $60 million with a bank syndicate led by Rothschild Australia Limited.
Tambang said in a statement the loan will carry four percent interest and will be repaid in gold, in seven years starting in June 1998.
"The loan will be used to boost gold production from the Pongkor mine in West Java," the statement said.
It said other banks included Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Commerzbank International SA.
The statement gave no other details.
Aneka Tambang plans to produce 1.8 tonnes of gold in 1996, unchanged from 1995.
It also produces nickel from its mining area on Sulawesi island.
